## About
GMD Chicago is a granite and marble showroom and fabricator at 3933 25th Ave in Schiller Park. We carry natural stone for countertops, from granite to marble to onyx and more, along with quartz.
Every slab is fabricated in our local Chicago facility by master stonemasons, and our experts hand-select the slabs we offer, inspecting each for structural integrity and veining.
Homeowners have given us a 5 rating across 692 Google reviews. Andrew coordinates each project, from choosing the stone to the day the installation crew arrives.

## Services
- Marble: Natural marble slabs for kitchen and bath countertops.
- Granite: Natural granite countertops, fabricated in our Chicago facility.
- Quartz: Quartz countertops you can select in person at our showroom.
- Quartzite: Hand-selected quartzite slabs for countertops.
- Laser-Precise Templating: Digital templating for seamless joints and accurate fits, including complex high-rise layouts.
- Fabrication: Each slab is cut and finished by master stonemasons in our local Chicago facility.
- Free In-Home Consultation: We come to your home to talk through your countertop project.
- Free Estimate: Share the details of your surface project and our team will review your plans.

## FAQ
Q: Can I choose my stone in person?
A: Yes. Our showroom is at 3933 25th Ave in Schiller Park, and one reviewer visited in person to select her quartz.

Q: Do you install bathroom countertops as well as kitchens?
A: Yes. Reviewers have had countertops installed in kitchens, bathrooms and a powder room.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Fill out the estimate request with the details of your surface project, or call us. Our team reviews incoming plans daily.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes, Saturday from 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Weekdays we are open 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and we are closed Sunday.
